assumptions: Police-officer or traffic-control-signal direction exception is ignored because the camera cannot see it.
Stop is interpreted as a full stop (max_speed 0.05) continuously inside stop_zone for at least 1000 ms, although no duration is stated.
The near side at a clearly marked stop line is interpreted as stop_zone, the last 10 m before stop_line.
Crossing stop_line inbound triggers the stop obligation; vehicles that never cross pass.
Any prior dwell in stop_zone before the first inbound crossing satisfies the rule; no maximum interval is enforced.
Anchor center is used because boxes are top-down vehicles whose centre is metric position, while bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not wheels.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first come to a full stop inside the approach waiting zone before crossing.

provenance.quote: at a clearly marked stop line
stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line

provenance.reason: Rule says 'shall stop' but gives no speed threshold; 0.05 interprets stop as fully stopped/still.
Rule gives no stop duration; 1000 ms is assumed minimal measurable stop to distinguish a stop from a slow roll.
Rule does not state crossing direction; to_right is inbound (+y) direction per line description vehicles approach from y<0.6 toward y>0.6.
Boxes are vehicles viewed from above; centre is metric position per line description, bottom_center is downstream AABB edge not wheels.
Rule states no maximum interval between stop and crossing; no time limit is enforced.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
